web.installCommand: d=$(pwd); while [ ! -f "$d/package-lock.json" ] && [ "$d" != "/" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; echo WORKSPACE_ROOT=$d; npm ci --include=dev --prefix "$d"

api.installCommand: d=$(pwd); while [ ! -f "$d/package-lock.json" ] && [ "$d" != "/" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; echo WORKSPACE_ROOT=$d; npm ci --include=dev --prefix "$d"
